title: kv-cache: add memory compaction and spillover-aware eviction to reduce fragmentation and paging
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: KV cache fragmentation and uncoordinated spillover to host memory were causing suboptimal throughput and elevated paging on long-running inference workloads. This PR introduces an in-process memory compaction pass plus spillover-aware eviction heuristics that prefer compactable regions and reduce page churn. Summary of changes: 1) compacting allocator and background compaction worker to defragment free segments and coalesce adjacent free spans, 2) spillover-aware eviction policy that scores entries by (last_access, size, fragmentation_score, model_priority) and biases eviction toward entries that will reduce overall fragmentation and page faults, 3) tighter coordination between continuous-batching scheduler and KV cache to mark large batch prefixes as cold candidates and avoid thrashing the GPU KV cache, 4) new metrics and tracing for fragmentation_ratio, compaction_cycles, spillover_events, and eviction_reasons, 5) feature flag runtime. Implementation details: compactor is a stop-the-world incremental mover for small epochs (configurable default 50ms) which relocates hot entries in-place using a copy-on-move pattern that updates shard-level references under the cache mutex. Eviction uses a weighted LRU where weight := size_bytes * (1 + fragmentation_score) / (1 + recency_factor) with an exponential backoff for recently promoted entries. Spillover now selects target pages using a compact-first strategy and writes to page-aligned mmap regions with advisory madvise(MADV_SEQUENTIAL) to reduce TLB churn. Backwards compatibility: on-by-default for main; can be toggled via KV_COMPACTOR_ENABLED and KV_SPILLOVER_POLICY env flags. Testing and benchmarks: microbench harness shows median P50 latency unchanged, P95 latency down 12% for seq_len>2048 workloads, and a 22% reduction in host-page fault rate under sustained multi-tenant load. CI: initially flaked on a race detected in the compactor under sanitizer builds; added additional synchronization and tests. Rollout: gated by feature flag, gradual canary to 10% of clusters for two weeks, fallback path will disable compaction if page_faults spike > 5x baseline. See linked Linear ENG-1209 and ENG-1243 for benchmark plans and rollout runbook.

// scheduler hint: mark prefix as cold to avoid KV thrash
if batch_size > config.large_batch_threshold { cache.mark_prefix_cold(request_id); }

/* spillover path: use posix mmap and madvise to reduce TLB churn */

release_notes: Improves KV cache memory usage and reduces host paging for long-sequence workloads. Adds a compaction worker and a spillover-aware eviction policy. Default-enabled with feature flags for rollout control. Notable impact: P95 latency -12% for seq_len>2048 in perf lab; host page fault rate -22% under multi-tenant stress tests.
